links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, FKGL) of LLM patient education materials with explicit sixth-grade prompt versus generic prompt
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 prompt B responses were more readable than prompt A (p<0.001); ChatGPT-4 SMOG 5.59±0.5, FKGL 4.31±0.7; rewrote existing PEMs to SMOG 5.14±0.3.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 prompt B responses were more readable than prompt A responses (p<0.001).

links.outcome: Whether LLMs can write or rewrite patient materials to a target sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 consistently rewrote existing materials to or below sixth-grade level (SMOG 5.14±0.3) and generated more readable responses than the other two LLMs (p<0.001).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 generated more readable responses (lower SMOG and FKGL scores; 5.59±0.5 and 4.31±0.7, respectively) than the other two LLMs (p<0.001) and consistently rewrote them to or below the specified sixth-grade reading level (SMOG: 5.14±0.3).
